z-m-27-01.title: Pane nzira dzingani dzekugovera macandies 6?
z-m-27-01.topic: Huwandu hwenzira dzekugovera macandies: kana macandies achisiyaniswa uye kana maoko asina chinhu abvumirwa
z-m-27-01.goal: Nzwisisa kuti mutsara 'huwandu hwenzira dzekugovera' oga hautari mhinduro imwe chete, uye unyore zvakare nyaya uchitaura iwe pachako mamiriro anodiwa kutara mhinduro (kana macandies achisiyaniswa, kana maoko asina chinhu abvumirwa).
z-m-27-01.material: Tinoda kugovera macandies ose 6 kuvanhu vatatu, 갑, 을, ne 병. 갑, 을, ne 병 vane mazita akatarwa, saka vanhu vakasiyana. Nzira dzekugovera macandies dzinoverengwa nemhedzisiro 'ndiani akagamuchira chii.' Kana mhedzisiro yakafanana, inzira imwe chete, uye kurongeka kwekupa macandies hakuverengwi. Nyaya ingori mutsara mumwe. "Pane nzira dzingani dzekugovera macandies 6 kuvanhu vatatu?"
z-m-27-01.thinking.0: Kutonga kana ruzivo rwakakwana usati wawana mhinduro
z-m-27-01.thinking.1: Kufanofungidzira kuti huwandu hwenyaya hunochinja sei kana mamiriro achichinja
z-m-27-01.thinking.2: Kutarisa nekugadzira nyaya dzine mamiriro akagadziriswa
z-m-27-01.thinking.3: Kunyora zvakare nyaya isina kujeka kuti ive nemhinduro imwe chete
z-m-27-01.prereq.0: Kunyora nyaya semapeya akarongwa uye kuzvinyora usina kusiya
z-m-27-01.prereq.1: Product rule ne sum rule (nhanho yechikamu chekutanga che 'counting cases' unit ye high school Common Mathematics)
z-m-27-01.prereq.2: H2 mukugoverwa kwenhanho yechikoro inongova label yekuoma mu plan yekugadzira iyi, kwete kugoverwa kwegiredhi rechikoro. Fungidzira kuti pfungwa dzekutanga dze counting-cases unit dzatodzidzwa.
z-m-27-01.s.s1.prompt: Kuti mutsara uyu mumwe oga uve nemhinduro imwe chete, chii chimwe chatinofanira kuziva zvachose? Sarudza zvose zvinoshanda.
z-m-27-01.s.s1.hint.0: Paradzanisa, sekudhirowa mutsara, mamiriro atonyorwa mumashoko enyaya nemamiriro asina kunyorwa.
z-m-27-01.s.s1.hint.1: Gadzirisa huwandu humwe chete we (갑, 을, 병) kuti mhedzisiro iramba yakadaro, uye funga kuti mamiriro api, kana achichinjwa, aizoita kuti mhedzisiro iyoyo ive yakasiyana kana isingagoneki.
z-m-27-01.s.s1.o.a: Zera revanhu vatatu 갑, 을, ne 병
z-m-27-01.s.s1.r.a: Zera harina hukama nenzira dzakawanda dzekugovera. Funga kuti ruzivo rupi runochinja nzira yekuverenga.
z-m-27-01.s.s1.o.b: Kana macandies 6 anosiyaniswa kubva kune mumwe
z-m-27-01.s.s1.r.b: Wakacherekedza kuti zvichienderana nekuti macandies anosiyaniswa here, kunyange kugovera kwenhamba kumwe chete kunoverengwa senzira dzakasiyana.
z-m-27-01.s.s1.o.c: Kana macandies anopiwa rimwe panguva kana ose pamwe chete
z-m-27-01.s.s1.r.c: Nyaya iyi yakagadzirwa kuverenga mhedzisiro chete uye kwete kurongeka kwekupa. Ndiro mamiriro atogadziriswa.
z-m-27-01.s.s1.o.d: Kana zvakanaka kuti mumwe wevanhu vatatu asagamuchire candy zvachose
z-m-27-01.s.s1.r.d: Wakacherekedza kuti kana nyaya apo mumwe anogamuchira 0 dzakasanganisirwa here dzinochinja rondedzero chaiyo yenyaya dzinogoneka.
z-m-27-01.s.s1.o.e: Kana 갑, 을, ne 병 vari vanhu vakasiyana
z-m-27-01.s.s1.r.e: Zvatonyorwa kuti vane mazita akatarwa. Paradzanisa ruzivo rwakapiwa neruzivo runoshaikwa.
z-m-27-01.s.s1.explain: Pane ruzivo rumwe nerwakashaikwa rwumbiri. Zvichienderana nekuti macandies anosiyaniswa here, kunyange nhamba dzakafanana, senge (갑 4, 을 1, 병 1), inova nzira yakasiyana kana macandies akagamuchirwa akasiyana. Uyewo, nyaya dzinogoneka dzinochinja zvichienderana nekuti ruoko rusina chinhu rwabvumirwa here. Kuti vanhu vanosiyaniswa uye kuti kurongeka kwekupa hakuverengwi zvatopiwa.
z-m-27-01.s.s2.prompt: Ngatigadzirisei nyaya apo macandies ose 6 ari rudzi rumwe chete uye vanhu vatatu vose vanogamuchira 1 kana kupfuura. Isa nzira 6 dzakasiyana. (huwandu hunogamuchirwa ne 갑 ndi a, hunogamuchirwa ne 을 ndi b, hunogamuchirwa ne 병 ndi c)
z-m-27-01.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza huwandu hunogamuchirwa nemunhu mumwe, uye utarise kuti sum yenhamba dzinogamuchirwa nevamwe vaviri inofanira kuva chii.
z-m-27-01.s.s2.hint.1: (4,1,1) ne (1,4,1) inzira imwe chete here? Tarisa nechiyero chemashoko enyaya che 'kana mhedzisiro yakafanana, inzira imwe chete.'
z-m-27-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Vanhu vatatu vose vane 1 kana kupfuura.
z-m-27-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Vanhu vatatu vose vanofanira kugamuchira 1 kana kupfuura imwe neimwe.
z-m-27-01.s.s2.ok.c2: Macandies haagoni kupatsanurwa, saka nhamba ndema integers.
z-m-27-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Sum yenhamba dzinogamuchirwa nevanhu vatatu inofanira kuva 6.
z-m-27-01.s.s2.explain: Pasi pemamiriro aya pane nzira 10 dzose. (1,1,4), (1,4,1), ne (4,1,1) dzinoverengwa senzira dzakasiyana nekuti munhu anowana macandies 4 akasiyana. Izvi nekuti vanhu vatatu vanosiyaniswa. Kunyange boka rimwe chete renhamba (1,2,3) rinoparadzana kuita nzira 6 zvichienderana nekuti ndiani anogamuchira zvakawanda sei.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.prompt: Panguva ino fungidzira kuti macandies 6 ose ane flavors dzakasiyana, uye zvakanaka kuti munhu agamuchire hapana. Zvichienzaniswa nekugovera macandies erudzi rumwe chete nemaoko asina chinhu abvumirwa (nzira 28), chii chinoitika kuhuwandu hwenzira?
z-m-27-01.s.s3.hint.0: Sarudza kugovera kumwe kubva panyaya yerudzi rumwe chete, (4,1,1), uye ushande zvakananga kuti kugovera uku kunoparadzana kuita nzira dzingani kana macandies asiyaniswa.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.hint.1: Funga nezvekusarudza, candy imwe neimwe, 'munhu upi pavatatu anoigamuchira,' uye uverenge kuti sarudzo iyoyo inodzokororwa kangani.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.o.a: Inodzikira. Nekuti macandies anofanira kusiyaniswa, mamiriro akaoma zvakanyanya.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.r.a: Kusiyanisa macandies hakuiti kuti kugovera kunogoneka kupi nekupi kunyangarike. Tarisa kuti kugovera kwenhamba kumwe chete kunoparadzana kuita nzira dzingani.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.o.b: Yakafanana, nzira 28. Nekuti huwandu hwemacandies nehwevanhu hunoramba hwakadaro.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.r.b: Kunyange huwandu hwemacandies nehwevanhu hwakafanana, mukugovera kumwe chete kwe (4,1,1) inzira yakasiyana kana ani anogamuchira macandies api akasiyana.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.o.c: Inowedzera. Nekuti kugovera kumwe kunoparadzana kuita nzira dzakawanda.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.r.c: Wakaratidza kuti kana macandies asiyaniswa, kugovera kumwe kunoputsika kuita nzira dzakawanda.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.o.d: Hatigoni kuziva tisina kushanda kuti chii chinoitika.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.r.d: Unogona kuenzanisa saizi usingaverengi zvose, nekutarisa kugovera kumwe chete uye kuti kunoparadzana kuita nzira dzingani.
z-m-27-01.s.s3.explain: Kana macandies ose akasiyana, candy imwe neimwe inosarudza munhu mumwe wevatatu, saka ndi3 kumhaka ye6, ndiko kuti, nzira 729. Iyoyo yakawanda zvikuru kupfuura nzira 28 dzerudzi rumwe chete. Izvi nekuti imwe neimwe yenzira 28 inoparadzana kuita nzira dzakawanda. Semuenzaniso, kunyange (4,1,1) oga inoparadzana kuita dzakawanda zvichienderana nekuti macandies 4 api anogamuchirwa ne 갑.
z-m-27-01.s.s4.prompt: Gadzirisa mutsara wekutanga uye unyore nyaya nenzira mbiri dzakasiyana dzekududzira kuti rimwe nerimwe rive nemhinduro imwe chete. Haufaniri kutsvaga mhinduro (nzira dzingani), asi unyore kuti zvijekese kuti mamiriro api awakawedzera.
z-m-27-01.s.s4.hint.0: Gadzirisa ruzivo rumbiri rwakashaikwa rwawakasarudza pakutanga, rumwe panguva, uye uruise mumutsara.
z-m-27-01.s.s4.hint.1: Dudziro mbiri dzinofanira kusiyana mumamiriro mamwe chete kana kupfuura. Sarudza kuti mamiriro api ekuchinja uye uanyore.
z-m-27-01.s.s4.selfAssess.0: Unogona kutaura mumutsara mumwe kuti mamiriro api akasiyana pakati pedudziro mbiri dzawakanyora here?
z-m-27-01.s.s4.selfAssess.1: Kana waverenga dudziro imwe neimwe, unogona kuziva kana macandies akafanana kana akasiyaniswa here?
z-m-27-01.s.s4.selfAssess.2: Mududziro imwe neimwe, unogona kuziva kana zvakanaka kuti mumwe agamuchire candy hapana here?
z-m-27-01.s.s4.model.0: Dudziro 1) Macandies ose 6 rudzi rumwe chete, uye zvakanaka kuti munhu agamuchire 0. Dudziro 2) Macandies ose 6 ane flavors dzakasiyana, uye zvakanaka kuti munhu agamuchire hapana.
z-m-27-01.s.s4.model.1: Inogona kunyorwa sehuwandu hwenzira dzekugovera macandies 6 akafanana kuti vanhu vatatu vose vagamuchire 1 kana kupfuura imwe neimwe, kana sehuwandu hwenzira dzekugovera macandies 6 anosiyaniswa kuti pasina anosiiwa.
z-m-27-01.s.s4.modelNote.1: Mhinduro iyi yakasarudza musanganiswa wechitatu wemamiriro (anosiyaniswa + wese anowana 1 kana kupfuura). Kunyange musanganiswa wakasiyana, unoshanda chero bedzi mamiriro akajeka.
